text: anya: Noticing a recurring pattern post-migration: fragments to headings that immediately follow a block-level element (image, blockquote, table) are getting deduped (e.g. #runbook -> #runbook-1) and our external links / linkcheck are failing. tom: Can you share a minimal repro? anya: Yep — from docs/ops/runbooks.md: ```markdown > Tip: make sure env vars are set ![arch](./assets/arch.svg) ### Runbook Steps to follow... ``` Links to /ops/runbooks#runbook 404 in linkcheck. Locally the generated id becomes `runbook-1`. felix: I can reproduce with both mkdocs-material and latest docusaurus content plugin. Looks like our slugifier dedupes when an element with no id precedes a heading. Previously headings got the predictable slug. sara: Short-term remediation options: 1) add explicit HTML anchors before the heading; 2) use explicit slug syntax if supported (e.g. `### Runbook {#runbook}`); 3) change all incoming links to deduped slugs. I prefer (1) as it keeps public URLs stable. tom: Agreed. Minimal anchor example: ```html ### Runbook ``` I'll open a small PR that adds anchors for the worst offenders and updates a migration note. anya: Can we run a repo scan to find potential pages? Something like: `git grep -n "^!\[" docs/ | xargs -I{} sh -c "sed -n '1,5p' {} | grep -q '^###' && echo {}"` — rough but should surface candidates. felix: I'll refine that script and run it in CI as a one-off. Also filing a follow-up to fix the slugify plugin so it preserves the old behaviour or at least documents it clearly. docs-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-1212--staging.docs.redwood.ai/ops/runbooks (build 1212) :white_check_mark: linkcheck shows failing fragment resolved for this page. sara: After merge let's run a full site linkcheck (`npm run linkcheck -- --full`) and collect any remaining fragments into a small triage board. tom: PR opened: redwood/docs#3201 — quick anchors + migration note (assigns: tom, reviewers: anya, felix). Please review when you get a sec. anya: Thanks all — short patch, big win for cross-links. We'll follow up on the slugify/plugin change and add a regression test in docs CI.
